name: bugfix
description: Diagnose, fix, and verify a bug with an iterate-until-green loop.

stages.name: diagnose
stages.task:
Reproduce and root-cause this bug. Produce a minimal failing case and a diagnosis (not just symptoms):

{task}

stages.name: fix
stages.task:
Fix the root cause identified below. Keep the change minimal and targeted; do not refactor unrelated code.
{stage.diagnose}

stages.name: verify
stages.task:
Run the failing case plus the regression suite. If anything still fails, say NEEDS_CHANGES and explain what failed.
{deps}

stages.name: review
stages.task:
Confirm the fix addresses the root cause, adds a regression test, and introduces no new risk.
{deps}
